title: Great locations!

author: BobArn2016

title: Eros was the host. He was...
text:
Eros was the host. He was late but he explained and was apologetic. It rained and so we only managed to do 3 joints. Thankfully he brought an umbrella and so we managed to squeeze out an extra joint (#3). 

It was unfortunate about the weather and others in the group cancelling, but we managed to meet people along the way and make friends.

Would have been a better experience if it was a group excursion overall. But Eros was very accommodating despite being late.
